description: hopeful 可以表示對未來樂觀、保持正面態度、因好跡象而受到鼓舞、有信心、語氣積極、滿懷期待、在不確定情況下仍樂觀，或形容某件事本身很有希望。不同替代表達的核心差別，是『optimism / positive attitude / encouragement / confidence / upbeat mood / anticipation / formal optimism / promising signs』。

words.note: 和 hopeful 最核心、最常用的近義詞之一。當某人相信未來會有好結果、即使存在不確定性仍抱正面期望時，optimistic 很自然。
words.example: She is optimistic about finding a new job soon.
words.exampleZh: 她對很快找到新工作感到樂觀。

exercises.original: She is hopeful that the economy will improve next year.
exercises.zh: 她希望並相信明年經濟會改善。
exercises.upgrade: She is optimistic that the economy will improve next year.
